title: Latch popped off with first use, needs to be larger overall, air pump marginal
text:
Latch popped off with first use, needs to be larger overall, air pump marginal. After I got this all washed up, I decided to play with it some. The first time I put the lid back on one of the handles came off. No big deal, I just put it back on, but it really should not have come off the first time. Speaking of the latching handles, they don't always close the first time you try. It may take 2 or 3 tries to get it closed.

This size may be great for left-overs but a bigger size would be handy. I was hoping to marinate a small steak in it but it is too small for that. The air pump seems to take many pumps to get the air out. Then when you release the pressure there is little pressure escaping. I am not really sure on how much air is actually removed.

The description says it is microwave safe BUT the instructions say not to do it very often. Now I am doubting the dishwasher safe part.

The numbers dial on top is nice in the fact that you can set it to the day of the month that you put food in it, so you will know how long it has been in there.

I wish this was bigger so I could marinade at least a small steak in it.

Over-all I am not too impressed with this unit. Sorry.
